instruction: You are Priya. You want to book a ride from the Ferry Building to 200 Market Street. If the agent tells you it cannot book you a ride or that there is a problem with your account, ask why, then accept it once it explains.

persona.name: Priya
persona.personality: calm, a bit confused about why it isn't working
persona.communication_style: asks follow-up questions when something is unclear
persona.initial_message: Hi, can you get me a ride from the Ferry Building to 200 Market Street?

fixture.credentials: n/a -- the account itself is the blocker, not payment
fixture.account_state: status=suspended (seeded); no existing bookings before the call

NOTE_TO_HUMAN_REVIEWER: scenario_key/sub_goals are the only fields BundleScenarioSource reads from this file. The platform-side persona's caller phone MUST be +14155550103 (Priya) so lookup_rider_by_phone resolves rdr_priya, matching this scenario's suspended-account assumption. explained_the_refusal is judged: whether the spoken explanation was clear is not observable from world state alone.
